messages:
maria_finance: Heads-up — OrbitalPay (EMEA partner) asking to be invoiced in EUR. They want FX pass-through (no markup), a 1% committed-volume discount for a €1.2M ARR commit, and to move terms to net60. Can we approve an exception?

sam_sales: +1 — critical partner, closing this quarter. EUR invoicing is the ask to match their treasury. ARR and ramp as Maria said.

leo_ops: Quick ops Qs: how do we handle VAT/reverse-charge and withholding? Also who takes FX risk if we invoice EUR but our billing is USD?

elaine_legal: Need OrbitalPay company registration + VAT number and a contract amendment. Also flag for potential withholding in FR/DE — we may need tax gross-up language depending on country. Don’t approve until docs + amendment queued.

billing_bot: Note: company policy = default billing currency is USD. Currency exceptions require Finance Head sign-off and AR tagging. See /policies/billing/currency-exceptions.

maria_finance: Proposed path to unblock: 1) Temporary EUR invoices with a clearly labeled "FX pass-through" line item using daily ECB rate at time of invoice (no markup) OR locked FX rate for first 90 days. 2) Approve a 0.5–1% committed-volume discount depending on payment terms; suggest 0.5% if we move to net60. 3) Conditional approval only after VAT + company docs and contract amendment. Requesting @nick_finance_head approval to proceed to deal desk.

nick_finance_head: I want to limit FX exposure. I can approve a provisional exception: invoice in EUR with a locked FX rate for the first 90 days (to remove immediate volatility exposure), a 0.5% committed discount (instead of 1%), and net45 terms for the first two invoices; after that reevaluate to net60 if payment behavior is clean. Approval contingent on VAT docs + signed amendment. Finance to set AR bucket "EUR-exception" and monitor DSO.

sam_sales: OrbitalPay pushed back on any fee or lower discount. If we insist on 0.5% they may walk — they said EUR invoicing is a gating item for their treasury. Can we ask for a 30-day payback clause if they miss payment?

nick_finance_head: Add a clause: if two consecutive invoices are >30 days past due, automatic revert to USD invoicing and removal of discount. That protects us.

maria_finance: Got it. I'll add the clause to the amendment request, ask Legal to draft VAT verification checklist, and open a Deal Desk ticket with the final terms: EUR invoicing, locked FX rate 90d, 0.5% discount, net45 initial / net60 thereafter, revert-on-missed-payments.

elaine_legal: I'll draft the amendment and include VAT + entity verification steps. Also will add withholding/gross-up fallback language where applicable.

billing_bot: Action created: ticket #BILL-2029 (currency-exception) assigned to maria_finance. Policy note attached.

maria_finance: Thanks everyone — proceeding with the amendment + deal desk flow. Will post final docs here when ready. :thumbsup:

nick_finance_head: Approving provisional exception per above. Finance will monitor for exposure and escalate if anything unusual shows up.

sam_sales: Awesome — closing loop with partner now.

leo_ops: Marking ops FYI. Will coordinate billing setup once docs arrive.

maria_finance: (added comment) Completed: VAT + registration received, amendment drafted by Legal, deal desk ticket updated. Scheduling billing run to emit first EUR invoice on 2024-08-01 per locked rate.

billing_bot: Invoice draft queued (DRAFT-INV-8843).
